LESSON: PLANTS ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: NATURAL
Topic 3.1: Plants ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Plants ENVIRONMENT. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. talk about plants in the immediate environment
2. observe plants in the immediate environment
3. talk about the uses of plants in the immediate environment
4. take care of plants found in their immediate environment e) appreciate plants Plant Such As Leaves and flowers found in their immediate environment Core-Competence to be developed: 140

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. talk about plants in the immediate environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to talk about plants in the immediate environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. observe plants in the immediate environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to observe plants in the immediate environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

3. talk about the uses of plants in the immediate environment
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to talk about the uses of plants in the immediate environment. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

4. take care of plants found in their immediate environment e) appreciate plants Plant Such As Leaves and flowers found in their immediate environment Core-Competence to be developed: 140
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to take care of plants found in their immediate environment e) appreciate plants Plant Such As Leaves and flowers found in their immediate environment Core-Competence to be developed: 140. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Plants ENVIRONMENT.
2. Explain Plants ENVIRONMENT to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Plants ENVIRONMENT.
4. Show that you can: talk about plants in the immediate environment
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Plants ENVIRONMENT. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Plants ENVIRONMENT important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. talk about plants in the immediate environment
2. observe plants in the immediate environment
3. talk about the uses of plants in the immediate environment
4. take care of plants found in their immediate environment e) appreciate plants Plant Such As Leaves and flowers found in their immediate environment Core-Competence to be developed: 140

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
